name: python-frontend
description: Serverless Python programming sandbox for education

paragraphs: This project combines React, Pyodide and Material UI alongside a handful of amazing open-source software to create a lightweight, in-browser educational platform for those who want to improve their Python knowledge, and those who want to author educational material for Python learners.
Once the website loads, everything happens purely client-side, no paid server, no subscription, and no installation required.
features: High-quality code editor via Monaco editor.
Support for breakpoints (click left of the line numbers at the window edge)
Line-by-line stepping (once the debugger is on a break)
Support for a number of built-in libraries through Pyodide, including time, random
